query: Nails to Tails Pet Salon, Tallahassee, FL
name: Nails to Tails Pet Salon
address: 1350 Mahan Dr Ste D-2, Tallahassee, FL 32308, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Tallahassee Lassie
reviewSamples.text: I feel very fortunate to have found this talented groomer. Her grooming area is spotless, quiet,  and well organized and visible when you walk in. She groomed my two toy poodles exactly as I ask to get ready for the summer heat. She finished in a timely manner and the price is reasonable.
